payload.title: omp has no placement for a chosen model
payload.body: Assay of install-placement (guided-install) found that on omp a model the operator chooses for a role has no placement: runDeploy with a non-empty models fails with one line naming the harness (as the unit's spec requires), and install's seedModelRoles seeds only the nearest built-in route. Whether guided-run should place chosen models on omp through its own config routes, or refuse the question there, is open; install-placement cannot decide it. Also open for guided-run: install still asks neither personas nor models and does not yet pass omitAgents or models.
